raw_segments.text: Casca, are not you moved when all the sway of earth shakes like a thing unfirm?
O Cicero, I have seen tempests when the scolding winds have rived the naughty oaks, and I have
seen T.H. ambitious oceans swell in rage and foam to be exalted with the threatening clouds.
But never till tonight, never till now, did I go through a tempest dropping fire.
Either there is a civil strife in heaven, or else the world too saucy with the gods
